verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs cover every part of the story. Founders can create and send invoices, and customers can pay online through a 'Pay now' button by credit card, ACH/EFT, or Apple Pay. Wave also notifies the user when an invoice is viewed, becomes due, or is paid. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the viewed/paid tracking and payment flow (all evidence is vendor marketing pages).

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Create unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records
Send professional invoices... Get paid fast via credit card, bank payment, or Apple Pay
Customers can click a “Pay now” button on invoices and pay instantly by credit card or secure bank payment (ACH/EFT)
Customers can pay instantly by credit card or Apple Pay when they view the invoice online using the secure 'Pay now' button
Know when an invoice is viewed, becomes due, or gets paid, so you can take the right actions to manage your cash flow.
